body.prompt: string (required) — the task for the KB agent (retrieve / ingest / experience / ...)
body.mode: string (optional, default 'sync') — 'sync': wait and return the result; 'async': return task_id immediately, the KB system always finishes the task in the background

permissionModes.label: Default (HITL)
